1.text: Nuko bene Data, ndabinginga ku bw'imbabazi z'Imana ngo mutange imibiri yanyu, ibe ibitambo bizima byera bishimwa n'Imana, ari ko kuyikorera kwanyu gukwiriye.

2.text: Kandi ntimwishushanye n'ab'iki gihe, ahubwo muhinduke rwose mugize imitima mishya, kugira ngo mumenye neza ibyo Imana ishaka, ari byo byiza bishimwa kandi bitunganye rwose.

3.text: Ndababwira umuntu wese muri mwe, mbwirijwe n'ubuntu nahawe, mwe kwifata uko mutari, ahubwo mutekereze mwitonze nk'uko Imana yagereye umuntu wese kwizera.

4.text: Nk'uko mu mubiri umwe dufite ingingo nyinshi, kandi ingingo zose zikaba zidafite umurimo umwe,

5.text: natwe ni ko turi kuko turi benshi, nyamara turi umubiri umwe muri Kristo, umuntu wese ni urugingo rwa mugenzi we.

6.text: Nuko kuko dufite impano zitandukanye nk'uko ubuntu twahawe buri, niba twarahawe ubuhanuzi duhanure uko kwizera kwacu kungana,

7.text: cyangwa niba twarahawe umurimo wo kugabura iby'Imana tugire umwete wo kubigabura, cyangwa uwigisha agire umwete wo kwigisha,

8.text: cyangwa uhugura agire umwete wo guhugura. Ugira ubuntu abugire atikanyiza, utwara atwarane umwete, ugira imbabazi azigire anezerewe.

9.text: Urukundo rwanyu rwe kugira uburyarya. Mwange ibibi urunuka muhorane n'ibyiza.

10.text: Ku byo gukunda bene Data mukundane rwose, ku by'icyubahiro umuntu wese ashyire imbere mugenzi we,

11.text: ku by'umwete ntimube ibyangwe, muhirimbane mu mitima mukorere Umwami wacu.

12.text: Mwishime mufite ibyiringiro mwihanganira amakuba, mukomeze gusenga mushikamye,

13.text: mugabanye abera uko bakennye, mushishikarire gucumbikira abashyitsi.

16.text: Muhuze imitima, ntimukararikire ibikomeye ahubwo mwemere kubana n'ibyoroheje. Ntimukiyite abanyabwenge.

17.text: Ntimukīture umuntu inabi yabagiriye. Mwirinde kugira ngo ibyo mukora bibonekere abantu bose ko ari byiza.

18.text: Niba bishoboka, mu rwanyu ruhande mubane amahoro n'abantu bose.

19.text: Bakundwa, ntimwihōranire ahubwo mureke Imana ihōreshe uburakari bwayo, kuko byanditswe ngo “Guhōra ni ukwanjye, ni jye uzītura, ni ko Uwiteka avuga.”

20.text: Ahubwo umwanzi wawe nasonza umugaburire, nagira inyota umuhe icyo anywa, kuko nugira utyo uzaba umurunzeho amakara yaka ku mutwe.

21.text: Ikibi cye kukunesha, ahubwo unesheshe ikibi icyiza.
